policy.description: reviewedVersion is the last upstream version reviewed by SwiftLocal maintainers. It is not automatically the version bundled in a release unless bundledVersionSource is present.

ffmpeg.name: FFmpeg
ffmpeg.bundledVersionNote: Windows release binary is copied from a local installation/build and is not lock-pinned in git.

tesseract.name: Tesseract OCR
tesseract.bundledVersionNote: The executable is copied from a local Windows installation and is not lock-pinned in git. tessdata is tracked separately by tools/tessdata.lock.json.

qpdf.name: QPDF
qpdf.bundledVersionNote: scripts/populate-tools-from-system.js contains a qpdf 12.3.2 fallback path, but the release binary itself is not lock-pinned.

libreoffice.name: LibreOffice
libreoffice.bundledVersionNote: Full builds copy LibreOffice from a local installation. Track the mature Previous Branch, not the newest feature branch.
